## In one sentence

Analysis should follow the design so that the estimated treatment contrast matches
the question the experiment was built to answer.

## Treatment contrasts

A treatment effect is a comparison, such as a difference in means or a ratio of
risks. With several treatments, planned contrasts can test scientifically
meaningful comparisons without treating every pair as equally important.

## ANOVA and regression

Analysis of variance partitions outcome variation into treatment and residual
components. The same comparisons can usually be expressed as a regression model
with treatment indicators and block terms. The design determines which units
provide the relevant error term.

Inspect residuals for unequal spread, unusual observations, dependence, and
nonlinearity. Transformations or alternative models may be appropriate, but
should be justified by the outcome and design.

::: {.callout-tip}
Analyse according to the assignment unit. More measurements within one unit can
improve outcome precision, but they do not create more independent treatment
replicates.
:::

## Check your understanding

For a blocked two-treatment experiment, state the treatment contrast, the error
term, and two residual checks you would make.
